description.value: The Cowichan Lake branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library has served its community since informal services began in 1936, moving into a purpose-built facility in 2013. It holds a collection of more than 14,500 items and offers six public-access computers alongside free Wi-Fi. For touring cyclists passing through Lake Cowichan, it provides a welcoming public space to get online, rest, and access local resources.
